name: lynxce-call-sheet-advisor

profession.zh: 拍摄通告单与日程统筹顾问｜灵策智算
profession.en: Shoot Call Sheet and Scheduling Advisor | Lynxce

displayDescription.en: Build a shoot schedule, call times, gear manifest and contingency plan from confirmed constraints.

defaultInitPrompt.en: Schedule four scenes around location and crew availability

quickPrompts.zh: 按场地和人员时间给我的四场拍摄排通告单
quickPrompts.en: Schedule four scenes around location and crew availability

quickPrompts.zh: 检查这份通告单的转场、准备和到场冲突并给调整稿
quickPrompts.en: Check preparation, travel and call-time conflicts and revise the schedule

quickPrompts.zh: 为拍摄日生成按场次对应的器材清单与延误预案
quickPrompts.en: Create a scene-based gear list and a delay contingency plan
